description_en: Queries the traffic data of a specified instance from the dashboard
description_zh: 查询指定实例的整理仪表盘流量数据
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-dashboard-metrics-flows --instance-id airec-cn-o400whm78004 --start-time 1586673466 --end-time 1586673466 --metric-type USERACTIONPV_COUNT --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDashboardMetricsFlows

parameters.help_en:
The metric type.

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_COUNT: The total number of page views (PVs).

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_COUNT: The total number of unique visitors (UVs).

USER\_ACTION\_PV\_RATIO: The traffic conversion rate.

USER\_ACTION\_UV\_RATIO: The traffic per capita
parameters.help_zh:
指标类型

USER_ACTION_PV_COUNT 整体流量规模PV

USER_ACTION_UV_COUNT 整体流量规模UV

USER_ACTION_PV_RATIO  流量转化率

USER_ACTION_UV_RATIO 人均流量
parameters.name: metric_type
